title: Tag
description: One strike attempt. Human tags and CV suggestions share this shape. A CV suggestion is a tag with source "cv", a confidence, and a status.

fight_id.description: Id of the fight this tag belongs to.

timestamp_ms.description: Time of the strike in the video, in milliseconds from the start of the file.

fighter.description: Corner of the fighter who threw the strike.

weapon.description: Strike type. Null only while a CV suggestion has no weapon guess.

outcome.description: Result of the strike. Null until an analyst sets it. Counting rules are open questions (see docs/stat-definitions.md).

target.description: Where the strike was aimed or landed. Null until an analyst sets it.

source.description: Who created the tag: an analyst or the CV model.

confidence.description: Model confidence from 0 to 1. Required (non-null) for CV tags, null for human tags.

status.description: Review state. Human tags are created as confirmed. CV suggestions start as pending.

created_by.description: Analyst username, or the model name and version for CV tags (e.g. "strike-tcn@0.1.0").

created_at.description: When the tag was created (ISO 8601, UTC).
